name: zrndr_span_alpha_blend_555_from_tex16_alpha8
description: zRndr::SpanAlphaBlend555FromTex16Alpha8 blends 16-bit texture data into a 5:5:5 destination span using an 8-bit texture alpha map.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification currently fails: original 0x49c560 is 502 bytes, the compiled source loop is 272 bytes, 52 relocation bytes are masked, 13 trailing VC NOPs are trimmed, and 442 unmasked byte mismatches remain.

The mismatch is explained by source-shape/codegen limits: the retail routine inlines the odd scalar and packed two-pixel alpha-map loops, while the current source uses restored helper calls for SpanTex16SampleIndex, BlendPixel555Alpha8, and BlendPair555Alpha5.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49c560 validates alpha-map sampling from g_spanActiveTexAlphaMap, 16-bit texel sampling from g_spanActiveTexels, source index construction from texU >> 20 plus masked texV shifted by texVShift, texU/texV step advancement, and destination advancement.

The original handles an odd-pixel scalar head before a packed two-pixel loop; alpha values below 8 skip, alpha values at least 248 copy source texels, and intermediate alpha values blend 5:5:5 channels.
The native smoke verifies scalar and packed pair blending, high-alpha copy, low-alpha skip, and that g_spanCurrentDst16 is not advanced by the source-faithful implementation.
